spec_match.rationale: Checks scrollIntoView capabilities on Element prototype and displays precise instructions on support status.

interactive.rationale: Allows real-time selection of three separate rows, driving side-by-side scroll animations in distinct columns.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Instructive real-world focus on the sticky clearance layout problem.

design_system.rationale: Faithfully utilizes design variables with a clear layout presentation.
